import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter and count the number of dogs by breed and gender
breed_gender_count = data.groupby(['Rasse1Text', 'SexLang']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=breed_gender_count, x='Rasse1Text', y='Count', hue='SexLang', palette='Set2')

# Customize the plot
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and Gender in Zurich')

plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter and count the number of dogs by breed and gender
breed_gender_count = data.groupby(['Rasse1Text', 'SexLang']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(data=breed_gender_count, x='Rasse1Text', y='Count', hue='SexLang', palette='Set2')

# Customize the plot
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.title('Number of Dogs by Breed and Gender in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Dog Breed')
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.legend(title='Gender')
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
